annotation.title_clean: Australian Privacy Principles guidelines (Privacy Act 1988, combined July 2019)
annotation.title_en: Australian Privacy Principles guidelines (Privacy Act 1988, combined July 2019)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC)
annotation.summary_en: OAIC's Australian Privacy Principles guidelines (July 2019 combined edition) explain the 13 APPs under the Privacy Act 1988: key concepts such as consent and personal information, permitted situations, and APP-by-APP obligations. Non-binding interpretive guidance. It is technology-neutral, with no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines are not legally binding; they interpret the 13 APPs in Schedule 1 of the Privacy Act
Consent must be informed, voluntary, current, specific and given with capacity
Collection must be reasonably necessary for an entity's functions; sensitive information needs higher protection
Entities must take reasonable steps to secure personal information and allow access and correction
APPs are technology-neutral and apply to biometric and online collection
